summary: Single nav component shared by home/docs/blog via a `variant` prop that only changes a small text tag next to the logo ('docs'/'blog') — the link set, brand link, and mobile menu are now identical across all variants (previously the home variant rendered a non-clickable <span> brand and a different spacer class than docs/blog, which was the root cause of inconsistent behavior between pages). summary: Shared nav component, markup only — all of its appearance comes from the page's stylesheet (landing.css for home, docs.css everywhere else). The `variant` prop does two things and only two: picks which link gets the `active` class, and switches the install href between '#install' and '/#install'. Adding a page family that should highlight NOTHING means widening the variant union with a value no link tests for — 'how' was added this session for exactly that, so /how-it-works/ pages do not falsely light up Docs or Blog.
